knownIssues.summary: Only the 11 canonicalMidSceneKeys are resolved at render time by SceneRenderer.jsx (MID_SCENE_COMPONENTS). The per-mid-scene 'aliases' listed below are historical registry names; they are NOT mapped to a component. The renderer Zod schema (sdk/schemas/videoConfig.schema.ts MidSceneKeys) now accepts only the 11 canonical keys, so an alias fails validation instead of rendering an empty slot.
knownIssues.guidance: Generators MUST emit only canonical keys.

layoutGeometry.source: Mirror of sdk/scene-layout/sceneLayout.js + sdk/layout/viewportPresets.js. knomotion-pipeline/pipeline/core/geometry.ts re-implements slot carving from these numbers and geometry.test.ts asserts it matches resolveSceneSlots(). Change both together.
layoutGeometry.safeBand: The outer `padding` px on every edge. Slots are carved inside it, so any non-background pixel in the band is content that overflowed its slot (render-check `edge_bleed`).

textMetrics.note: Heuristic text budgets derived from each mid-scene's base font size (desktop). Lines do not wrap in textReveal/heroText; lineCapacity > 1 there reflects shrink-to-fit headroom (fitFontSize, floor 60%), not wrapping. avgCharWidth = fontSize * charWidthRatio. maxChars per field = floor(slotWidth * widthFraction / avgCharWidth) * lineCapacity, capped by maxChars. maxCount per array = min(manifest count limit, floor(slotHeight / (fontSize * lineHeightRatio * rowAllowance))). Used by the Stage 7 prompt (budget stated up front) and the Stage 8 `text_budget` rule (error when exceeded).

contentShapes.note: Stage 3 tags each planned scene with one contentShape; Stage 7 may only choose a mid-scene from that shape's subset for content slots (the header slot is exempt). Stage 8 `content_shape` errors otherwise. A SUBSET, not a forced choice.

keyConfig.revealType: typewriter | fade | slide | mask | blurSlide | charByChar | glitchIn | variableTypewriter | glitchCycle (default: fade). blurSlide/charByChar/glitchIn/variableTypewriter/glitchCycle are remotion-bits powered.
keyConfig.direction: up | down | left | right for slide and mask (mask also accepts top | bottom | center; up/down map to top/bottom). Default: up.
keyConfig.showCursor: Boolean — blinking cursor during typewriter reveal (default: true)
keyConfig.linesBeats: Per-line beats { start, hold, exit, emphasis } preferred over container beats

keyConfig.heroType: image | lottie | svg | roughSVG | emoji | custom (default: image)
keyConfig.heroRef: URL, asset path, lottie registry key, or emoji depending on heroType
keyConfig.beats: Requires exit and one of entrance/start (start is an alias for entrance)

keyConfig.cards: Array of card objects { icon?, image?, label?, sublabel?, color?, variant?, layout?, animated?, beats? } — minItems: 1
keyConfig.animation: fade | slide | scale | bounce | flip | mask | cascade | centerRipple (+ fadeIn/slideIn/scaleIn/bounceIn aliases) (default: cascade)
keyConfig.cardVariant: default | bordered | glass | elevated | gradient | flat (flat renders as default) (default: default)

keyConfig.items: Array of { text, checked?, icon?, color?, animated?, beats? } or plain strings — minItems: 1
keyConfig.revealType: pop | slide | fade | scale | spring | bounceIn | slideIn | scaleIn | fadeIn | listReveal (default: pop). listReveal is remotion-bits powered.
keyConfig.icon: Static presets: check | checkmark | tick | bullet | dot | arrow | star | diamond | circle | square | plus | minus. Lottie presets: lottieCheck | lottieTick | lottieSuccess | lottieStar. Or a custom emoji string. (default: check)
keyConfig.iconColor: Theme key (primary, secondary, accentGreen, accentBlue, doodle) or hex/rgb (default: accentGreen)

keyConfig.callouts: Array of { text, icon?, color?, shape?, animated?, beats? } or plain strings — minItems: 1
keyConfig.animation: pop | float | slide | scale | fade (default: float)
keyConfig.jitter: { x, y } pixel offsets for organic placement

keyConfig.left: { title?, subtitle?, icon?, items?, color?, backgroundColor? } — left panel content
keyConfig.right: { title?, subtitle?, icon?, items?, color?, backgroundColor? } — right panel content
keyConfig.mode: standard | beforeAfter (default: standard). 'beforeAfter' uses before/after media + slider.
keyConfig.animation: slide | fade | scale | bounce | reveal (default: slide)

keyConfig.icons: Array of { iconRef, label?, color?, animated?, beats? } — minItems: 1
keyConfig.animation: fadeIn | slideIn | scaleIn | bounceIn | cascade (default: scaleIn)

keyConfig.cards: Array of { title?, content?, variant?, size?, beats? } — minItems: 1

keyConfig.label: Description text below the number
keyConfig.emphasis: high | normal | low (default: high) — selects number color tier
keyConfig.countFrom: Number — start value for countUp animation
keyConfig.color: Theme key (primary, secondary, accentGreen, accentBlue, textMain, ...) or a literal CSS color (hex/rgb/hsl).
Theme key (primary, secondary, accentGreen, accentBlue, textMain, ...) or a literal CSS color (hex/rgb/hsl).

keyConfig.code: String — source code with \n line breaks
keyConfig.language: Any string, passed through to the remotion-bits highlighter (default: javascript). Highlightable set depends on the bundle; not validated. Common: javascript, typescript, jsx, tsx, python, bash, json, html, css, markdown, go, rust, cpp.
keyConfig.highlightLines: Array of line numbers to highlight (1-indexed)
keyConfig.focusLines: Array of line numbers to focus (dims others)
keyConfig.title: Optional title above the code block

layouts.description: Single content area with optional header
Side-by-side columns (auto-converts to rowStack on mobile)
Complex layout: header + row + columns below

backgroundOptions.layerNoise: Boolean — adds subtle film grain overlay

transitions.description: Circular reveal like a clock hand

audioChannels.narration: TTS audio file with optional startFromSeconds offset
audioChannels.music: Background music with fade-in/out, loops by default
audioChannels.sfx: Array of sound effects, each at a specific atSecond offset

unsupported: Real-time data binding (all content must be static at render time)
Custom font loading from arbitrary URLs
Multi-track video overlays (only single visual layer per scene)
